_doc: Exceptions for src/__tests__/tools/productCompleteness.test.js (W0-8d, T0-33). barrel: a Product file exports it, P/index.js does not, on purpose. gallery: P/index.js exports it, the gallery has no P.<Name> of its own. An entry that no longer applies fails the test. 'evidence' (optional) is a file that must still contain the text: it proves the thing is drawn some other way.
